critique.evidence: The headline, borderline query, BLOCK→ALLOW comparison, “False positive suppressed” status, and ranked legitimate precedents make the core claim understandable without narration. However, the next action is not clear: the only desktop/tablet CTA is the unexplained global “ENTER RED MODE,” it is absent on mobile, and the tablet navigation obscures part of the results explanation.
critique.fix: Add a prominent, screen-specific CTA such as “Inspect decision evidence” or “Continue to Arena,” with a brief outcome-oriented label; expose it consistently on all viewports and prevent the tablet header from covering the explanatory text.
